skill.name: sleek-design-mobile-apps
skill.description: Design and manage mobile app UI projects in Sleek through its REST API, including project creation, chat-driven screen generation, component listing, and screenshot rendering.
skill.summary: Create, update, and screenshot Sleek mobile app screens from natural language requests.
skill.author: sleekdotdesign

security_audit.summary: Most external command findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks and API examples, not executable code. Real risks remain because the skill requires SLEEK_API_KEY, makes bearer-authenticated requests to https://sleek.design, sends user prompts or image URLs to Sleek, and documents project deletion. No evidence of prompt injection, hidden command execution, or unauthorized third-party hosts was found.

remediation.issue: API key exposure and broad scopes
remediation.suggestion: Use the narrowest Sleek API key scopes needed for each task and never log Authorization headers or full key values.

remediation.issue: External transfer of prompts and image URLs
remediation.suggestion: Ask before sending sensitive prompts or private image URLs to Sleek, and redact confidential information before submission.
Require explicit confirmation with the project name and project id before calling DELETE /api/v1/projects/:id.
Keep API examples clearly fenced and state that the skill does not include executable scripts or shell commands.

semantic_findings.title: User Content Sent to External AI Service
semantic_findings.description: The skill instructs agents to send the user design request directly as message.text and allows image URLs that Sleek servers may fetch. Sensitive prompts or private images could leave the user environment.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documentation explicitly says to use the user words directly in message.text and warns that image URLs are fetched by Sleek servers. This strongly supports a third-party data-transfer risk, although it is documented and intentional.

semantic_findings.title: Destructive Project Deletion Capability
semantic_findings.description: The skill documents DELETE /api/v1/projects/:id and the projects:write scope. A broad Sleek API key could allow project deletion if the user request is misunderstood or lacks confirmation.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The endpoint table and example section explicitly include project deletion, and the documented projects:write scope enables create and delete operations. The risk depends on token scope and user confirmation practices.

content.user_title: Design Mobile App Screens with Sleek
content.value_statement: Mobile app screens are hard to turn from ideas into visuals quickly. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Sleek projects, chat prompts, and screenshots.
actual_capabilities: Create new Sleek projects for mobile app design work.
List existing projects and retrieve project details.
Send natural language chat messages to generate or update screens.
Poll chat run status until a screen generation job completes or fails.
List project components and identify affected screens.
Request individual or combined screenshots for generated screens.
limitations: Requires a Pro+ Sleek account and a SLEEK_API_KEY environment variable.
Uses network calls to https://sleek.design and cannot work fully offline.
Image URLs in prompts may be fetched by Sleek servers.
Does not render or edit designs locally without the Sleek API.

use_cases.title: Prototype a New Mobile App
use_cases.description: Turn a product idea into a Sleek project with generated screens and screenshots.

use_cases.title: Iterate on Existing Screens
use_cases.description: Send focused design changes to a selected screen and review the updated screenshot.

use_cases.title: Review Project Components
use_cases.description: List project screens, inspect run status, and prepare visuals for design review.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple App Concept
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Sleek project named Budget Buddy and design a mobile app for tracking weekly spending.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Screens from Requirements
prompt_templates.scenario: Structured feature request for a first design pass.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design onboarding, home, and settings screens for a wellness app. Use a calm visual style and show screenshots when complete.

prompt_templates.title: Update a Specific Screen
prompt_templates.scenario: Targeted iteration on an existing Sleek project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the dashboard screen in my Sleek project and update it with stronger empty states, clearer metrics, and a primary action.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Full Review Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow with polling, component review, and screenshot delivery.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a mobile commerce project, wait for the run to finish, capture each new screen, and also capture a combined overview screenshot.

output_examples.input: Design a habit tracker app with onboarding and a home dashboard.
output_examples.output: A new Sleek project is created, the design request is sent, the run is polled, and screenshots of the created screens are returned.

output_examples.input: Make the settings screen clearer and show me the result.
output_examples.output: The matching screen is selected, the update request is submitted, and a fresh screenshot of the edited screen is delivered.

output_examples.input: List my Sleek projects and show the screens in one project.
output_examples.output: The skill retrieves available projects, lists components for the selected project, and summarizes the screens available for review.

best_practices: Use the narrowest Sleek API key scopes needed for the current task.
Confirm before sending private prompts, confidential image URLs, or destructive requests.
Always review the returned screenshots before requesting another design iteration.
anti_patterns: Do not use a broad API key when read-only or screenshot access is enough.
Do not include secrets, customer data, or private URLs in design prompts.
Do not send another chat message before the active Sleek run reaches a terminal state.

faq.question: What account is required?
faq.answer: The skill requires a Sleek Pro+ account because API access is gated to that plan.

faq.question: Which environment variable is required?
faq.answer: Set SLEEK_API_KEY to a Sleek API key with the scopes needed for your task.

faq.question: Does the skill make network requests?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed to call https://sleek.design for projects, chat runs, components, and screenshots.

faq.question: Can it create screenshots?
faq.answer: Yes. It requests PNG or WebP screenshots for individual screens or combined project views.

faq.question: Can it edit existing screens?
faq.answer: Yes. It can target a specific screen when the project and screen identifier are known.

faq.question: Should I send sensitive image URLs?
faq.answer: No. Sleek servers may fetch image URLs used as visual context, so avoid private or sensitive URLs.
